description:
Nutrition per 100g or 100ml (energy, fat, carbohydrate, sugars, protein, salt), the ingredients list as printed (allergens included), how many ingredients it lists, country of origin, alcohol strength, pack size, description and today's price, for particular products.

Products are looked up by product id (store-prefixed, as returned in product results), by the retailer's own item numbers (skus with store, as printed on its receipts), or by name (query). ingredients_incomplete marks an ingredient list on record that is cut short, which cannot show that an ingredient is absent. A product looked up by id or item number answers even after it has left the shop's range: in_range_today false marks one, and its price is then the last one recorded (price_date), not today's. Ids with no product on record are listed in not_found. Results carry a note that nutrition and ingredients are for information only. Each product returned costs one credit.

limit.description: Most products to return for a query (default 5, at most 50).

product_ids.description: Product ids exactly as another tool gave them, e.g. ['tesco:300793546', 'dunnes:100873410', '000000000000387044'], up to 50. The sure way to name a product.

query.description: Product name words, e.g. 'kellogg's corn flakes'.

skus.description: The shop's own item numbers, as printed on its receipts, e.g. ['100873410'], up to 50. Needs store. An Aldi article number can return several variants.

store.description: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl: needed with skus; narrows a query; left out, all five.

name: get_product_details

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

alcohol_abv_source.description: Where the strength came from: the retailer's own listing, worked out from its alcohol units per bottle or can, or the same barcode at another store
alcohol_abv_source.title: Alcohol Abv Source

allergy_advice.description: The retailer's allergy advice, kept apart from the ingredients: what the product contains and may contain, e.g. 'Contains: Milk. May contain: Nuts.'; missing where the retailer publishes none
allergy_advice.title: Allergy Advice

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

in_range_today.description: For a product looked up by id or item number: false when the shop's latest catalogue day does not list it, so price is its last recorded price and not a price to buy at today
in_range_today.title: In Range Today

ingredient_count.description: How many ingredients the label lists (a compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one); missing when it cannot be told reliably
ingredient_count.title: Ingredient Count

ingredients_incomplete.description: True when the list on record appears cut short, so it is not the full list and cannot show that something is absent
ingredients_incomplete.title: Ingredients Incomplete

ingredients_source.description: Where the ingredient list came from: the retailer, the same product (same barcode) at another retailer, or Open Food Facts
ingredients_source.title: Ingredients Source

nutrition_source.description: Where the nutrition values came from
nutrition_source.title: Nutrition Source

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time, where the retailer states it
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

offer_text.description: The offer as the shop words it
offer_text.title: Offer Text

origin.description: Every country the label states, where it was made and where its main ingredient is from, e.g. 'Ireland', 'Ireland, EU, non-EU' (produced in Ireland using EU and non-EU chicken) or 'China, Spain, Argentina' for a blend; missing where none is stated
origin.title: Origin

origin_text.description: The origin statement in the source's own words
origin_text.title: Origin Text

price.description: Shelf price in euro on price_date: today's, unless in_range_today is false
price.title: Price

price_date.description: The day price was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD
price_date.title: Price Date

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

hint.description: What to try, when a name found nothing
hint.title: Hint

not_found.description: Requested product_ids with no product on record
not_found.title: Not Found

title: Nutrition, ingredients and product details
